messages:
thomas: FYI SDK 2.8 rolled to canary ~30m ago. We're seeing a small but consistent class of failures: downstream routes that do structured model binding return `signature_mismatch` at request time for some quantized llama variants. Not widespread but reproducible in canary.

sara: saw that too. Error rate ~3.6% on canary traffic for routes using the new structured outputs. Stacktrace points at sdk/runtime binding layer where the SDK encodes function schemas differently.

viv: important to note this is an SDK->runtime binding mismatch, not the model itself. Quick options: (A) pin SDK to 2.7 for affected customer routes, (B) rollback SDK 2.8 entirely, (C) hotpatch runtime adapter to accept legacy schema. My preference: targeted SDK pin for production cohorts + adapter patch in parallel. Lower blast radius.

elena: agree with targeted pin. We should apply an SDK pin to the "stable-embed-*" and "chat-structured-*" route cohorts for prod and canary while we validate the adapter. Also add a compatibility note in the release notes advising devs about function/schema changes.

deploybot: canary digest: https://deploys.redwood/canary/1748456789 7: overall green except sdk-binding-route cohort showing 3.7% `signature_mismatch` on canary. No increase in token latency.

thomas: created a PR with an adapter shim and unit tests: https://git.redwood/sdk/pulls/4521 7: adapter passes local and integration tests but needs canary validation. I'll keep the PR small to avoid broad churn.

sara: I'll open the pin request. Proposed pin metadata: ```
- sdk: "2.7.4"
  routes:
    - "chat-structured-*"
    - "stable-embed-*"
  reason: "SDK 2.8 schema encoding changes -> signature_mismatch on structured bindings"
  owner: "eng-sdk"
  applied_at: "1748458200"
```

deploybot: applied SDK pin to cohort "prod-structured-routes" at 1748458200 by @sara. Pin config visible in deploy dashboard.

viv: monitoring plan: run overlay traffic with SDK2.8 -> adapter shim in canary; run compatibility test harness (1000 structured calls) every 5m. If signature_mismatch rate >5% OR customer-facing errors >1% for 15m => trigger rollback.

elena: release-notes copy suggestion: "SDK 2.8 includes changes to function/schema encoding which may affect structured-output bindings for some quantized models. If you rely on structured model binding, pin SDK to 2.7.4 or contact support for help migrating."

thomas: support ticket template for customers who see the issue: ```
Subject: Structured-binding errors after SDK 2.8
Body:
- SDK version used: <version>
- Route name(s): <route>
- Error sample: signature_mismatch: <payload>
- Model(s) affected: <model>
- Request id(s): <ids>
```

sara: added rollback criteria to the pin record and to the PR. If canary error rate for these routes exceeds 5% sustained for 10m, deploybot will auto-trigger rollback/unpin.

viv: I'll run the compatibility harness now and post the first pass in ~20m. Will also add a smoke job that asserts zero signature_mismatch on the shim path.

elena: TL;DR: targeted SDK pin applied to structured routes cohort, adapter shim PR open, monitoring + rollback thresholds set, release notes blurb drafted, support template created. We'll reassess after canary runs. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
